none: PAS NLM-460575: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C CARAV(SIVS P?) F AVG] ; R/ [S]ALVS [AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (AD 286-293) (Reece period 14). Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CARAV(SIVS P?) F AVG]. Reverse description: Salus standing left feeding snake at altar and holding vertical sceptre. Reverse inscription: [S]ALVS [AVG]. Diameter: 21.4mm, Weight: 3.42gms, die axis: 6. RIC V, pt 2, p. 541, cf. no. 983.…
